brief: UBS sales desk positioning note (S&T) on US hedge fund and long-only crowding ahead of this week's earnings. Hedge funds are long crowded into US names reporting this week (score +9.6) and into the broader US region (+1.2). Short HF crowded names (score below -7): FUBO, VVV, WMT. Very heavily long HF crowded names (score above +21): DIS, INTU, KEYS, NVDA, WMG. A combined hedge-fund-crowding and long-only-ownership screen flags a positioning tailwind in names that are hedge fund crowded longs while mutual funds are simultaneously underweight: AMZN, BAC, BRK/B, COST, CVX, DIS, ET, FTNT, LMT, META, MMM, MO, MSFT, NEM, OXY, PG, PSX, PYPL, RTX, TSLA. DOW and GD have fallen out of the top 3 names on that combined screen. A separate sector-level table (hedge fund versus long-only) ranks stocks only against sector peers, not on an absolute basis, and is available via a linked spreadsheet. The note reports positioning data and does not argue a directional market thesis.
